heroTitle: Choose how many classes you want to take
heroDescription: Flexible plans with no commitment. Pay for the number of classes that fits your lifestyle.
planChangeInfoText: You can upgrade your plan at any time by paying only the price difference. Your subscription dates don't change and unused classes remain until the end of the month.
upgradeModalMessage: You will only pay the price difference. Your subscription dates won't change.
faqA1: Unused classes remain until your current period ends. Upon renewal, credits reset according to your plan.
faqQ2: Can I upgrade my plan anytime?
faqA2: Yes, you can upgrade at any time by paying only the price difference. Downgrading is not allowed.
faqA3: No. All plans are monthly and you can cancel anytime.
adminCannotBuy: Administrators cannot buy plans. Log in with a client account.
buyError: Could not start the purchase. Try again.
